name: PlayerContractRegistrationManager
tagline: Player contracts, squad registration and wage bill – one plug-and-play Power Apps component.
description: Keep every player contract and the squad list legal: negotiation to registration with window, permit, squad-size and homegrown rules; expiry pipeline with options, extensions and releases; live wage bill against budget. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages with built-in demo data.
features: Registration rules: windows, permits, senior and non-homegrown limits, under-21 list
Club options, extensions with cost preview, releases
Search, 10 quick filters, filter drawer, grouping, bulk actions, CSV export
